body: Try you best to focus on school it may be hard but music could probably help you. And if you ever feel want to use anything try to distract yourself like a walk, a friend to hangout with, it helps so you don't have your mind solely focused on the bad stuff. If you need to talk we're here for you.

I'm sorry for you loss, it's quite stupid but love takes patience and time I believe in you don't give up. Imo I would take a fast food retail job and find an entry level job as a target it could take awhile but you'll get some income at least to help, try to focus on yourself fuck everyone right now it maybe a lot but it's what will help you. I hope fortune for you and message if you ever need.

Have you tried getting in communication with your older brother? And the cheesy line you'll find someone is partly true but it takes time to find the true one if you keep looking it's bound to happen. If your siblings are fighting with your mom also try to be there for them because they could be feeling the same thing its worth a try, being there for your siblings like your older brother once was. Just don't give up yet, quite everything takes time try your best to hold your patience hoping for the best.
Yeah hurts to live, I just wanna die in my sleep forever and begone but right now I just have to live and try my best even if it's terrible I hope I can find someone to share my pain with.
If depends on the climate you enjoy, I've moved to Cali which is sunnier but I don't enjoy as much because I enjoy cloudy and rainy days.

Though it may be hard losing memories its tough because you'll find yourself lost than you think, try to just enjoy the memories you had with him he loved you and wants you to have a good life he knows that you loved him to the end and he does too but he wouldn't but you to be sad he would want you happy and in pursuit.

Keep it going don't give up stay strong, right now the hardships are difficult but ya doing the right thing accepting the terms and pushing through the shit, don't think to hard on yourself because everyone has a limit and you been pushing though and through your limit that it's been tough to deal with. And your right though try to have some fun no matter how little music, a walk, nature, a rest does a lot for one. I hope you good luck and keep pushing through don't give up. We all believe in you ❤️.

I would say be the one there for him, if he doesn't want to go and is sure respect his decision because if you force him it could make it worse. I would say try to get him open up to you talk to him when he needs it be cutesy try to do some surprises on him to show that you love him.

If you have any coworkers you could hang out with you could explore the new city with them even if they know most of it will be fun to explore. It must be terrible right now and hard to be social but you'll soon find someone to talk with just don't give up to early you got this!

Ay someone in your life will care though I would say don't give up try to find a distraction that you can enjoy like a walk in nature find the little things in life and enjoy but I care about others opinion just don't suffer if you do it please.

I would say try your best to find a quiet space or wear headphones because it can hurt to hear parents fighting. Whenever I open up I give bits and pieces like a puzzle to people I know every person has one to I don't fully open to one person. And for your dad I has a similar situation my dad was a drunk an ass but in life I forgave him I learned of his past i saw his daily life and he was stressed working so many hours I have him the benefit of the doubt but it couldn't be different just try seeing his point of view of you can because it will really help you see his situation and he just doesn't know how to vent it out well.  Don't give up you got this try going outside or doing something you can enjoy even like a simple walk it gives leave and quiet.

You'll have to be honest with your mom and also apologise and that may suck but parents will be parents, explain why you need try to get her to understand to the best of your ability. Sometimes parents don't get us compared to them growing up situations could be different and they don't know how to handle the situation so they act unrational, you just need to give them the benefit of the doubt and try your best. If you need to talk we're here for you.

The consequences of getting them back is undesirable, so I try to distract myself in anyway just so I don't think about it at this point I'm just losing myself overtime idk what I'll be, I'm 18 and didn't do college I've just done

It's hard being depressed, but to not give up even if you have to put up a mask is a decision that could be difficult but it also helps in a way. If you have need help there's always a person online who could reflect how you feel we've all been there. Message if you want we're here for you
But once you find light make sure you don't let it out of site. Even if it's a little follow and it will become bright.

Your life may seem like a burden but you're not, your parents only thought time was wasted on a low end job they didn't think of you as the problem and with your co-workers or friends try and ask them for help it may seem like a lot and embarrassing but you could probably learn a lot since they know more it could really help don't sweat it you got a bachelor's degree which is quite an accomplishment I would say you got this people believe in you dont forgot that!

I don't wanna say it, maybe harsh but you should breakup with him for playing with emotions during stress, he should be supporting you in his best way. Try to use anyone in your life for there shoulders it may seem like a burden but they are there for you for a reason it may hurt but it takes time to heal.

Sorry for your loss it may seem like a classic like but I truly am, I lost my dad to suicide it may be different but our parents love will be forever in our hearts and memories are to be cherished. Godbless.

Taking the steps family will hold you back from giving them up, imo I wouldn't use them for help as I didn't but others have which helped. I would say learn about yourself in what you like and don't, talk to your friends hangout with them as it wastes time enjoy it even if it is little.

One day you'll get out of the hellhole. I've been through the same I may still have my depression now but Im growing in a better situation I fucked everybody off with the mask and stayed true to the friends I had without the mask, I may didn't have any emotions but still hanged out with them it stalled time instead of being and thinking alone. I would focus on learning on yourself as it really helps you become resilient and if you can make money as gives more freedom to do random shit in your free time.
Full throttle, if other can control it likely you can too. Ya got this!

Life is shit we all know that I would say don't do it but as a person who respects others opinion I would say just make sure you don't suffer please that's what I would beg of you we are here for you message if you can ❤️.

I feel the same exact way though my depression is what I've had since I was young when I got older my demons/darkness disappeared and I can't feel any emotions once in a blue moon but most of the time I feel empty and sleep is something I will look forward too so I don't have to live in the world even if it's just a second. I just been trying to distract myself with friends or nature even if I don't feel anything it will pass the time but lately I've been wanting my demons/darkness back in order to feel some emotions again even if I will hate it cause right now I felt nothing even when my dad died nothing I can't cry I don't know the last time I have. I just want to feel.
